projects.title: INTERVIEW TTS

projects.title: FRAUD DETECTOR

about.bio_headline_prefix: I'm Mikel Romero. To me, technology isn't just a tool — it's
about.bio_1: I'm a profile in constant learning. I love pulling the thread and seeing how far the branches reach — and even better, watching them eventually connect with each other.
about.bio_2: But exploration without focus doesn't produce solutions. Software doesn't live in a vacuum; it's a tool that must deliver value and withstand the pressure and changes of the real world.
about.bio_3: That's why I balance my fascination for development, AI, and MCP protocols with strict engineering fundamentals (Spec Driven Development, Test Driven Development, relational modeling, and asynchronous architecture).
